Pack 10 Days of Clothes in a Carry-On
One Voltairs bag holds 18 to 22 lb of clothes. Compressed to 40% of their original size, that is about 10 days of outfits in a standard carry-on.

Each bag swallows jeans, tees, a sweater, underwear, and socks, then compresses to roughly 3 inches thick. Two bags come in every kit: around 10 days of mixed outfits inside a standard carry-on or backpack.
No bag-drop queue, no carousel wait, no $56 fee each way. Walk on, walk off, and keep your $112 every round trip.

Checked bags cost money and time: the drop-off line before security, the wait at the carousel after landing, and $56+ each way in fees. Voltairs removes all three. The kit costs $89.99 once and pays for itself on the first round trip.
Compress in Seconds. No Rolling, No Kneeling.
The included 30W multi-function pump pulls the air out in seconds. It recharges over USB-C, doubles as an LED light, and inflates things too.

The pump ships with multiple nozzles, so it inflates air mattresses, pool floats, and camping gear as easily as it deflates your Voltairs bags. The built-in LED works as a reading light or emergency torch.
Anti-rip nylon, an IPX8 water-proof shell, and an airtight D-ring zipper keep your clothes compressed, dry, and odor-free from door to door.

Most compression bags fail at the seal. They slowly leak and your clothes expand mid-trip. The Voltairs D-ring zipper glides shut and stays airtight, so what you compress at home is exactly what you unpack at the hotel.
Packing cubes organize. Roll-up bags squeeze. Only powered compression actually shrinks your clothes and keeps them that way.

settings.heading: Will the compressed bag fit in my carry-on?

settings.text: Yes. Each bag measures 18.5″ × 11.8″ × 5.9″ and compresses down to roughly 3″ thick, sized for standard carry-ons and backpacks. Your suitcase still needs to meet your airline's size rules; Voltairs just makes sure everything fits inside it.

settings.heading: Is it guaranteed to shrink my clothes by 60%?

settings.text: Honestly, no. Up to 60% is the maximum we measured, and the result depends on the fabric. Fluffy items that trap air, like sweaters, hoodies, and jackets, compress the most. Dense fabrics like denim compress less. Most mixed loads still shrink far beyond what rolling or packing cubes can do.

No. The 30W pump is USB-C rechargeable, has a long-lasting battery, and doubles as an LED light. It deflates a full bag in seconds, and with the included nozzles it inflates air mattresses and pool floats too.

settings.heading: Will my clothes come out wrinkled?

settings.text: Compression presses clothes flat rather than crumpling them, so jeans, knits, and casual wear come out fine. Fold delicate shirts on top of the stack and give them a quick shake-out when you arrive.

settings.heading: How much actually fits in one bag?

settings.text: Up to 22 lb of clothing per bag, roughly 8 to 10 days of outfits once compressed to about 40% of their original size. The kit includes two bags.

settings.heading: What's new in this updated kit?

settings.text: This is version 2 of the Voltairs kit, rebuilt around feedback from our first version, with a focus on the seal, the zipper, and the pump. If you own V1 and wonder whether to upgrade, email us at info@voltairs.com and we will give you an honest answer.

settings.heading: What if it doesn't work for me?

settings.text: Every kit comes with a 100-day money-back guarantee. If it does not save you space and money, return it for a full refund. No questions asked.
